description: The figure presents three pie charts showing the distribution of problems by correctness status under “with knowledge” versus “without knowledge” conditions in a Zero-Shot setting, split by difficulty level (easy, medium, hard). Each pie chart contains 4 slices corresponding to the legend categories: N+K+ (teal/green), N−K+ (pale yellow), N−K− (orange), and N+K− (red). In the easy chart, the slices are approximately N+K+ 55.4% (teal), N−K+ 38.3% (pale yellow), N−K− 4.6% (orange), and N+K− 1.7% (red). In the medium chart, the slices are approximately N+K+ 58.8% (teal), N−K+ 35.4% (pale yellow), N−K− 4.0% (orange), and N+K− 1.8% (red). In the hard chart, the slices are approximately N−K− 37.9% (orange), N−K+ 37.3% (pale yellow), N+K+ 18.1% (teal), and N+K− 6.7% (red). Percent values are printed inside the slices, a legend is shown to the right, no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the ordering of slice sizes varies by difficulty (with the hard chart showing the orange and pale-yellow slices as the largest).
